# Record comments (`services/comments/`)

Plain-text comments with in-app @mentions on a customer invoice, a supplier invoice (bill) or a bank line (migration 986 `record_comments`; master plan wave 5, M14). Route: `pages/api/accounting/record-comments.ts`; UI: `src/components/accounting/comments/CommentsPanel.tsx`, mounted in the invoice drawer, the bill page and the bank line drawer.

## Caller contract
- `listComments(companyId, userId, type, recordId)` → `{ comments (live, oldest first, max 500), mentionable }`; `createComment`, `editComment`, `deleteComment` (soft). Failures are `CommentError` (400 text/mentions, 403 not the author, 404 record/comment not found or another company's) or `ImpersonationForbiddenError`.
- Every write judges everything before its first write (a 4xx commits): Login-as (`assertNotImpersonating`, first), the record (company-scoped lookup, 404), the text, the mentioned people (members only, 400), then the INSERT/UPDATE. The integration suite proves a refused request leaves no row and no notification.
- Who may comment: owner, admin, manager (`withWriteAccess`); everyone who can read the record reads the thread. These are exactly the roles 954's `user_notifications_check` lets send, so a mention by the lowest commenting role (manager) succeeds and notifies, and 954's trigger and recipient function are unchanged (no definer, no `app_definer_reviews` row).
- Mentions: `notifyUsers` kind `comment_mention`, `ref_id` = the record, `href` = the record's page, dedupe key `comment:<id>` (an edit notifies only people not yet told). In-app only; NO email. Names come from 714's `approval_company_member_name`; the mention list from 708's `approval_company_other_members`.
- Plain text everywhere: stored byte for byte (NUL dropped, trimmed, 1-4000 characters), rendered by React as text with `whitespace-pre-wrap`. Never add `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
- The table holds the rest: tenant RLS (FORCE), author and stamps are the session's and the clock's (column grants), only the author updates (42501), deleted is final (23514), no DELETE privilege.
- Writes are rate limited per company and user (30 a minute, literal at the call site so the rate-limit key census reads it).
